title: How to Apply
subtitle: Complete your UAE visa application in 3 simple steps

steps.title: Choose Visa Options
steps.description: Select your residency status, application type, and the suitable visa type. If you are a GCC resident, choose the GCC resident option.

steps.title: Fill Application Form
steps.description: Enter your personal details and upload the required documents such as passport copy and photo.

steps.title: Pay & Submit
steps.description: Review your application, complete secure payment, and receive your application reference.
